module.confirmUninstall: Uninstalling removes the Wajub settings, keys and signing secrets. It keeps your orders, their payments, and the record of their Wajub payments, refunds and notes (the tables wajub_payment, wajub_refund and wajub_order_note), which a new install finds again. Continue?
